affinity.notes: Mineralized armor load paths, crystal protrusions, rooted mass, dust, and fractured terrain provide multiple Earth construction dimensions.

anatomy.notes: Two arms and two legs are complete, armor load paths are credible, and both equipment grips are coherent.

archetype.notes: Banner, seal, sword guard, and centered military posture strongly communicate a formation commander.

counterplay.notes: Glowing fractures are diffuse across armor, weapon, and terrain rather than identifying one readable binding joint or load-bearing fault after commitment.

finish.notes: The cinematic canvas is fully rendered with strong material separation and no extra subject, text, or watermark.

framing.notes: The single complete figure, sword, standard, and all extremities remain inside the canvas.

identity.notes: Skull, sword, command seal, and disciplined posture remain, but the required small command pennant has become a large full standard.

tier.notes: The image preserves a bridge-only commander identity without claiming a canonical T1-T5 form.
